nfcbc13fb8f.headline: In 27 years, US business invested 47 billion dollars in Kazakhstan's economy
nfcbc13fb8f.summary: US companies have invested about $47 billion in Kazakhstan's economy over 27 years, with around 160 American company representative offices operating in the country.
nfcbc13fb8f.why: Foreign direct investment from the US is significant for Kazakhstan's economic development and international business ties.
